description: This file contains the implementation of the MessageTrait in the GuzzleHttp PSR7 package, providing common functionality for HTTP message requests and responses, including header management, protocol version, and body stream handling.

methods.name: getProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP protocol version used in the message.

methods.name: withProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns a new message instance with a specified HTTP protocol version.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves all headers as an associative array.

methods.name: hasHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header exists by name.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns all values for a specified header.

methods.name: getHeaderLine
methods.description: Returns all header values concatenated into a comma-separated string.

methods.name: withHeader
methods.description: Returns a new message with the specified header set to the given value.

methods.name: withAddedHeader
methods.description: Returns a new message with the specified header added to existing values.

methods.name: withoutHeader
methods.description: Returns a new message without the specified header.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Retrieves the message body as a StreamInterface instance.

methods.name: withBody
methods.description: Returns a new message with the specified body stream.
